CAR-01-BESave-car question from the AI and the customer actions endpointCAR-01 — Saved car in the AI chat, backendCode review90%

Acceptance criteriaКритерии приёмки (5)

  • TeamThe AI answer carries car_in_message (the user's message names a valid car) and the car it understood
  • TeamCar messages of an unfinished identification are kept in a 24-hour draft on the customer and sent to the AI; the draft grows while the AI needs more info and is cleared when it does not
  • TeamThe question {text: 'Хотите сохранить автомобиль в системе?', type: 'save_car', params: [car]} is added only when status is not need_more_info, car_in_message is true and the customer has no saved car; car is combined from all draft messages
  • TeamPOST /private/customers/{customerId}/actions with type save_car saves params[0] as the customer's car and marks the question of message_id answered; unknown type or invalid params → 400
  • TeamWith a saved car the AI gets it as saved_car and does not ask for the car again; the first greeting names the saved car
